interpretation: Irradiation contrasts trace the trajectory with a clear peak (mean rho 0.4955 at 45 min, profile range 0.4244, 88% of argmaxes at or beside that peak). Flight contrasts do not: their mean profile is essentially flat (peak 0.0824, range 0.1157) and only 46% of their best-matching timepoints fall near it, so the argmax is arbitrary. Spaceflight is NOT a time-shifted radiation response. The per-contrast shuffle test passes 26 of 35 contrasts and is too permissive to be read on its own.
